body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized upright camera, 39 W x 57 H x 33 D mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact upright block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring upper right, flash window upper left, shutter top front-left, slide switch top rear right, USB-C in the bottom. Idea CRYSTAL TO ASH, a phase change: the lower body is an ordered faceted crystal plinth in translucent PLA with crisp planar facets, glowing faintly from the charge light at the USB-C. Moving up, the facets turn opaque light grey and crack into a Voronoi mosaic with widening black joints; the tiles crumble into grains; round the lens everything is black, granular fuzzy-skin texture like ash, the swirl into the void of image[2]. Only the lens sits in a small, perfectly smooth gloss-black dome with an engraved scale like image[3]: a black hole has no hair. Soft upright volume like image[4]. Facets give the grip, Voronoi joints over the electronics are vents. Collared shutter, recessed switch, red index triangle on the lens ring, frosted flash window, strap eyelet, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
